description: Count accounts opened inside the window, including any opened exactly at either endpoint.

a.request: How many accounts were opened from '2011-03-29 15:06:59' through '2015-02-02 09:47:08', both endpoints included, comparing `date_account_opened` as text?
a.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) >= '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) <= '2015-02-02 09:47:08'

b.request: Count the accounts whose `date_account_opened`, compared as text, is greater than or equal to '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and less than or equal to '2015-02-02 09:47:08', so both endpoints are included.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) >= '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) <= '2015-02-02 09:47:08'
b.raw: Count the accounts whose `date_account_opened`, compared as text, is greater than or equal to '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and less than or equal to '2015-02-02 09:47:08', so both endpoints are included.

c.request: How many accounts were opened between '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and '2015-02-02 09:47:08' (compare `date_account_opened` as text)? Count accounts opened inside the window, including any opened exactly at either endpoint.
c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) >= '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) <= '2015-02-02 09:47:08'

d.request: Count the accounts whose `date_account_opened`, compared as text, falls between '2011-03-29 15:06:59' and '2015-02-02 09:47:08', including accounts opened exactly at either endpoint.
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts WHERE CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) >= '2011-03-29 15:06:59' AND CAST(date_account_opened AS TEXT) <= '2015-02-02 09:47:08'
